name: harness-command-prompt-device-origin

instance.text: Summarise the failing test in one line.

notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:249-262 (a prompt carries text, attachments and a request_id) and 487-488 (prompts and steers are idempotent by request_id). origin is the device-source member the connector needs (plan §13.2: request_id = "dev:" + msg_id, origin = user / device(id, seq)); adding it to a prompt is a spec/v1 change, so every contract-1 decoder MUST ignore it until it is adopted (plan §13.7). This golden exercises exactly that ignore path.
